A previously asymptomatic young adult male suffered exertional sudden cardiac arrest during baseball pitching, resulting in transient loss of consciousness requiring CPR for return of spontaneous circulation. This represents a Class I indication for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) placement for secondary prevention, pending formal risk stratification and confirmation.
